threats.threat: Acoustic background is repeatedly classified as novel external events.
threats.mitigation: Adaptive baseline and spread, onset gating, hysteretic rearming, sustained-presence separation, and a quiet-rate acceptance gate.
threats.evidence: epoch-1 failure analysis and V5 source invariants

threats.threat: The pet attributes its own buzzer or probe to the environment.
threats.mitigation: Self-sound mask window, learned sound coupling, and a zero-external-event probe gate.
threats.evidence: V5 acoustic model; epoch-2 hardware evidence remains UNKNOWN

threats.threat: ADC multiplexer carryover makes the light sensor appear as microphone activity.
threats.mitigation: Discard the first A1 conversion after cross-channel access and test A0 covering without mechanical contact.
threats.evidence: V5 sampler and preregistered LDR-only gate

threats.threat: Human-readable UI and telemetry exceed the ATmega328P flash envelope.
threats.mitigation: Relocate labels to documentation and the host decoder; use icon/numeric OLED semantics and framed binary telemetry.
threats.evidence: V4 compile failure, committed baseline, and zero firmware string literals in V5

threats.threat: Observing the system through OLED or serial materially changes the timing signal being interpreted as external jitter.
threats.mitigation: Rate-limit rendering, cache outputs, compensate serial transmission time, and preserve production firmware with telemetry disabled.
threats.evidence: V5 display and telemetry paths; independent timing validation remains UNKNOWN

threats.threat: The capture tool opens or resets an unrelated USB serial device.
threats.mitigation: Require one explicit existing path, perform no scanning, and send no bytes.

threats.threat: EEPROM corruption or a version mismatch produces unsafe settings.
threats.mitigation: Magic/version validation and default reset before settings are applied.

threats.threat: A favorable source-size reduction is misrepresented as a successful AVR flash result.
threats.mitigation: Candidate compile status remains UNKNOWN until a repository-bound linker report is captured.

threats.threat: A piezo voltage spike damages the analog input.
threats.mitigation: Declared 100 kOhm series and 1 MOhm bleed network plus gentle-stimulus limitation.
threats.evidence: HARDWARE.md; calibrated electrical characterization remains UNKNOWN

threats.threat: The adaptive execution plane rewrites evaluation or promotion authority.
threats.mitigation: Contracts, thresholds, evidence, firmware identity, and promotion fields remain outside the firmware.

residual_unknowns: repository-bound AVR flash and SRAM measurements for V5
independent replication on another physical Uno and sensor assembly
long-duration EEPROM endurance and settings corruption
protected holdout stimuli and independent evaluator custody
release signing, deployment monitoring, and operational rollback evidence
